reviewer: AI agent /root/notepad_review; independent second source reviewer
method: Read primary labels, then independently inspected Git first-parent diffs and exact original/new Git source ranges. Verified 22 endpoint and 22 whole-file SHA256 values and exact old/new source byte equality for all 11 events. No detector output inspected.
coverage: Second review of all 11 labeled positive targets only. Not a second exhaustive ordinary-history negative audit or discovery inventory.

events.reason: Confirm exact complete field declaration and same continuing role. It crosses the retained nCharLimit-through-pzOutput field sequence within the same struct. Adjacent version comment removal does not edit the declaration or turn this into wrapper restructuring. Anchoring the much longer continuing field sequence is a defensible minimal-move convention.

Confirm exact assertion reorders after the continuing dirty-cache guard and WAL guard. Same function and same structural nesting; not a line shift or wrapper change. Assertion and following device guard are adjacent independent statements, with no enclosing moved source construct counted.

Confirm complete unchanged device guard (including its return) crosses dirty-cache/WAL checks. Retain one event for whole if, no separate return child. The executing order changes, so identity does not rely on semantic equivalence.

Confirm full usage definition is byte-identical in the renamed file and source path changes ext/wasm→tool. This is a whole-function transport under the study file-relocation policy; it is not an independent function extraction. Keep file-rename subtype visible.

Confirm full main definition is byte-identical in the renamed file and source path changes ext/wasm→tool. Count once at function scale, not additional inner statements. This shares one file-rename revision with usage and is not a statistically independent repository sample.

Confirm exact field declaration crosses multiple retained Parse fields; its preprocessor condition remains SQLITE_OMIT_PROGRESS_CALLBACK with the same polarity. Guard transport does not create a changed declaration. Reorder is unambiguous against the longer retained field sequence.

Confirm exact field shifts from before oldmask/newmask to after them. Minimal-move convention treats retained oldmask/newmask pair as reference and one nQueryLoop declaration as moved; do not also count oldmask/newmask as converse movements. Source alone cannot recover editing gestures, but endpoint identity and relative order are definite.

Confirm full named function deleted from select.c and inserted unchanged into walker.c. Same signature, body and role; no copied surviving original endpoint. Whole target independent of differently edited adjacent callbacks.

Confirm full named function deleted from select.c and inserted unchanged into walker.c. Distinct Select parameter and function identity prevent confusing it with Expr callback; unchanged descendants are carried and not extra events.

Confirm complete byte-identical function moves within callback.c across sqlite3CheckCollSeq, findCollSeqEntry, and sqlite3FindCollSeq. Anchor the longer retained sequence, not changed line numbers. This is a same-file whole-function reorder.

Confirm complete byte-identical function transfers from build.c to callback.c. Changed preceding documentation is outside the function endpoint. No descendant target should be added for this same transport.

limitations: Two AI reviewers are not a human-adjudicated gold standard.
Reorder direction uses minimal moved-construct convention relative to a longer retained sequence; does not claim knowledge of developer editing gestures.
Two whole-function targets come from one unchanged file rename; report separately from extraction and keep per-revision clustering visible.
